# Every third-party image CI, the e2e stack and the worktree checks pull, copied
# to ghcr.io/miwi35/mirror/<target> by .github/workflows/mirror-images.yml
# (weekly and on demand). They pull the copy, never the upstream registry:
# Docker Hub's anonymous pull limit took CI down twice (9–10 Oct.), then
# public.ecr.aws's anonymous data limit took an e2e job down (12 Oct.) — GitHub
# runners share their IPs. A new package is private: make it public (package
# settings) before anything references it.
#
# <target name:tag>                 <source>
# A source pinned by digest (@sha256:…) is copied at that digest, and the copy
# must keep it: the references pin the same digest.
wiremock:3.9.1                      docker.io/wiremock/wiremock:3.9.1
mercure:v1.0.2                      docker.io/dunglas/mercure:v1.0.2@sha256:e5d8f06a60f2feb5e91f7ba2046d9184f6339b3498b5d2f5adaeb5bcb080bfc7
buildkit:buildx-stable-1            docker.io/moby/buildkit:buildx-stable-1
uv:latest                           ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:latest

# Docker Hub official images, one line per tag the repository uses.
